summary: 多币种/汇率实现首片 on BASE 9e0991f (Lead ruling B: contracts-only; cross-owner settlement/revenue/cash/invoicing and verify_integrity remain out of scope). Adds a real managed FxRateSnapshot ORM model in pmo_plugins/contracts/models.py with contracts migration 0007 (CreateModel + vendor-aware SQLite/PG UPDATE/DELETE append-only guards; no core migration, makemigrations clean), and contracts/fx_services.py: record_fx_rate (owner/finance, company lock, exact business date including future registration per PH-308, version increment, dry_run zero-write, plugin-prefixed audit, no historical rewrite), resolve_fx_rate with exact-date lookup and NO nearest-date fallback, resolve_fx_ref, one-time ROUND_HALF_UP convert_cents/convert_original_amounts with book gross=net+tax and 10^12 bounds, fx_rate_list, and contract_line_fx_snapshots (original/book/rate/missing; non-CNY lines require a frozen fx_rate_ref or are reported fx_rate_missing without date fallback). The contract write path is integrated: approval_services._normalize_lines accepts currency/original_net_cents/original_tax_cents/original_gross_cents/fx_rate_ref, rejects CNY rows carrying original/FX data, requires member+effective date context for non-CNY, resolves/validates the frozen rate (including rejecting a frozen ref whose effective_on is later than the line business date), verifies client book amounts equal the one-time conversion, and review_version persists currency/original/fx_rate_ref on created ContractLine rows; change_services._derive_deltas and _apply_approved_change use the same normalization and persist the same fields for effective change versions. Non-CNY writes without an exact frozen rate are rejected before any version/line write; historical rows and amounts are never recomputed. UI: fx-rates history_read page + fx-rate-save business_write; owner/finance write, auditor read, PM project-line scope, member denied, disabled-module history read. Tests test_v1_fx.py (8) + _http.py (3): record/list/version/exact-date/no-fallback, permissions/disabled module, one-time conversion, DB/model append-only guards, CNY/non-CNY/missing contract-line display, write-preparation helper, non-CNY contract approval writes currency/original/fx fields, change-version write, invalid no-rate rejection. Deviations: version configuration UI does not yet surface currency/original fields (services/API contract supports them; future UI wiring); cross-owner integration and verify_integrity FX branch remain out of this B slice; payment/warranty term original-currency persistence is not included (line-level only).

review.reviewer: independent PH-321 multi-currency implementation reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - future-dated FX rates are forbidden, contrary to the frozen PH-308 contract: `record_fx_rate` rejects `effective_on > timezone.localdate()`, while PH-308 §3 explicitly allows registering future effective rates (they must merely not be used for earlier business-date conversions). This is an implementation narrowing of a frozen contract without an ADR/planning change. Fix: allow future effective dates in record/list (append-only/versioning still applies), and add regressions proving a future rate can be recorded but is not selected for an earlier conversion date.

BLOCKER - an explicit `fx_rate_ref` can bypass the business-date bound: `prepare_contract_line_fx` accepts a ref and converts immediately without checking that the referenced snapshot's `effective_on` is <= the contract-line `effective_on` (and without checking its version/currency pair are still the frozen ones beyond namespace/kind/id/version lookup). Once future rates are registrable (or via a direct crafted ref), a future rate could be applied to an earlier contract line, violating PH-308's 'future rate not used for historical conversion'. Fix: validate the referenced snapshot's effective_on against the line's business date, its base/quote pair against the line currency, and reject future/out-of-pair refs with tests.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: managed FxRateSnapshot + contracts 0007 CreateModel with org/base/quote/effective_on/version uniqueness, Decimal(18,8), source, created_by, algorithm_version and vendor-aware SQLite/PG UPDATE/DELETE guards; fx_rate_list/resolve exact-date/no-nearest fallback/ref resolution; one-time ROUND_HALF_UP convert_cents/convert_original_amounts with gross=net+tax and 10^12 bounds; record uses owner/finance, company lock, version increment, dry_run, audit; non-CNY contract-line writes in approval_services._normalize_lines/review_version and change_services._derive_deltas/_apply_approved_change persist currency/original/fx_rate_ref and reject missing rates, CNY carrying original/FX, client book mismatches; invalid/no-rate rejection occurs before version/line writes; canonical history_read fx-rates page + business_write fx-rate-save, owner/finance/auditor/pm/member and disabled-module history reads; 18 changed files within the 18-path whitelist, no core migration (contracts 0007 leaf). B-scope exclusions (cross-owner integration, verify_integrity FX branch, payment/warranty original persistence, UI currency input) are honestly disclosed in the report.
